Class RoutingEvent

java.lang.Object
jdk.jfr.Event
dev.tamboui.toolkit.jfr.RoutingEvent
public final class RoutingEvent extends Event
JFR duration event for a single toolkit routing operation.

This event is started at the beginning of EventRouter.route(...) and committed at the end.
